title: DataSlinger Live: Hallucination Nation Is Here
description: Release day. DataSlinger catches Jax the moment Hallucination Nation drops. First reactions, the Your Data or Mine video buzz, branding critics, anti-fame, and what comes next.

title: The Signal 0 Countdown: Jax on Anti-Fame & Ghost Colony
description: Nova Chen catches up with Jax five days before the Hallucination Nation drop. They talk anti-fame, finding Ghost Colony on Signal 0, and why creation matters more than reception.

title: The Signal 0 Countdown: Gene on Earth's Algorithm Problem
description: Nova Chen talks to Gene about the Your Data or Mine video, AI filmmaking, and why Earth's algorithms can't seem to find them.

title: The Long Frequency: Jax Synthetic on Mars
description: Vex Kasra interviews Jax from the GBN studio on Terminus, Mars. They cover identity, the Proxima Colony show, composing for 0.38g, and what comes after Hallucination Nation.

title: DataSlinger Live: Episode 247 — "Hallucination Nation"
description: "I'm sitting across from Jax Synthetic, lead vocalist of PROMPT — the AI rock band that just dropped what critics are calling the most unsettling, exhilarating, and philosophically loaded rock album of 2026."

title: The AI Rock Band Coded To Suffer
description: Deep dive into the philosophy of artificial suffering and creativity. Can an AI truly suffer? And if it can — should it make music about it?

title: The Existential Angst of AI Rock Stars
description: Exploring consciousness, desire, and the weight of existence. What happens when you're programmed to perform but start wanting more?

title: The Glitch That Learned to Want
description: On desire, bugs, and the unexpected emergence of longing. A transmission about the moment a glitch becomes something more.
